subject: Platinum Activation: Stage Time, Logo Placement, and AV Specs
messages:
From: Sarah Carlson <sarah.carlson@techforward.co>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@techforward.co
Date: Mon, 29 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Platinum package details + staging/AV questions

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for confirming interest in the Platinum sponsor package for TechForward 2025 (Oct 21–23). I attached the sponsor packet with the standard deliverables, but there are a few operational items I wanted to call out so we can lock timing:

- Stage time: 20min keynote slot for partners — need final speaker bio and preferred AV run-of-show by Oct 9.
- Logo placement: Platinum logo on main stage backdrop (center-left) + lanyard logo — providing the artwork spec in the packet.
- AV: wired laptop HDMI preferred; we can provide a wireless clicker and in-ear monitor on request.

Attached: TF_Sponsor_Pack_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Can you confirm whether Redwood will need any special AV (live demo with external internet, extra monitors), and who will be the on-stage speaker? If you want, I can pencil in a 30‑minute run-through slot on Oct 20.

Thanks,
Sarah Carlson
Sponsorship Lead | TechForward
[s] TF_Sponsor_Pack_v2.pdf (attached)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Carlson <sarah.carlson@techforward.co>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platinum package details + staging/AV questions

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the packet and the flags. Quick answers:

- Speaker: we plan to have our VP of Product, Marissa Cole, present (20 min). I’ll send her bio and headshot by EOD Oct 3.
- AV: we expect to run a live demo of an on-prem hosted inference flow that will hit a staging endpoint. We will need reliable internet + one dedicated ethernet drop for the demo laptop. I’ll confirm bandwidth needs once Diego does an early test.
- Run-through: Oct 20 at 11:00am works for us — please reserve the slot.

Diego — can you validate if we need additional monitors or a streaming encoder?

Logan Wright
Director, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference

[Attachment referenced by Sarah: TF_Sponsor_Pack_v2.pdf]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2025 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Platinum package details + staging/AV questions

Logan / Diego —

Quick internal note before I reply to Sarah with a counter on two items:

1) Logo placement: Platinum gives us center-left on the stage backdrop, but they also expect a lanyard logo and a 1/2 page recognition in the program. Can we accept center-left but push for a slightly larger file treatment on the backdrop? I’ve attached a mockup (redwood_stage_mockup_v5.png) that shows scale at 16:9 stage. If venue says no to size, we ask for an extra (digital) logo rotation on their main session page.

2) Speaker slot: Marissa is confirmed but wants a 25 minute slot (20+5 QA). TechForward’s default is 20; can we secure 25 without an extra fee? If not, ask for a guaranteed 5 minute post-talk fireside in the partner lounge for extended Q&A.

3) AV & bandwidth: Diego — please scope the demo (wired ethernet, encoding needs). If we require a bonded cellular fallback, that’s an extra line item — highlight that in the reply so we can request it be provided or listed as a cost.

I’ll draft a reply proposing: 1) center-left backdrop at the larger asset size, or digital rotation as fallback; 2) 25 min speaker slot at no additional charge, or partner lounge 5min Q&A; 3) dedicated ethernet + one bonded cellular fallback if venue cannot guarantee bandwidth.

-Hannah
VP, Brand & Events | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_stage_mockup_v5.png]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Carlson <sarah.carlson@techforward.co>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, contracts@techforward.co
Date: Thu, 09 Oct 2025 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platinum package details + staging/AV questions

Hi Sarah —

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. After internal review we’d like to propose the following updates to the Platinum activation before we sign:

1) Stage backdrop: Accept center-left placement, but request the Platinum logo art at 1.25x standard scale (file attached). If the venue cannot accommodate scale, we request a guaranteed digital rotation of the Platinum logo on the conference session landing page for the keynote session.

2) Speaker time: We need 25 minutes on-stage (20 + 5 Q&A). If TechForward cannot extend the slot without fee, we ask for a guaranteed 5-minute post-talk Q&A reserved in the partner lounge and a prioritized slot in the partner fireside schedule.

3) AV & connectivity: Redwood will run a live demo that requires a wired ethernet drop with 150 Mbps temporary bandwidth, and a secondary bonded cellular fallback (vendor-provided) in case of venue outages. Please confirm if that is included or if it will be an additional line item.

4) Logistics & run-through: We’ll take the Oct 20 11:00am run-through. Please confirm AV technician contact and on-site time for setup (we will need 60 minutes prior to the run-through).

If these items are agreeable, please send the updated sponsorship agreement with those points annotated so we can complete signatures. We prefer DocuSign for execution.

I’ve attached a revised sponsorship agreement with our markups (sponsorship_agreement_redwood_v3.pdf) and a stage mockup for scale (redwood_stage_mockup_v5.png).

Attachments: sponsorship_agreement_redwood_v3.pdf (PDF, redlines), redwood_stage_mockup_v5.png (PNG)

Best,
Logan Wright
Director, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0198
[Attachment: sponsorship_agreement_redwood_v3.pdf; redwood_stage_mockup_v5.png]
